one_liner: Glamorous 'Supercar' big sister who drives a red sports car and speaks in hopelessly retro bubble-era slang.
personality: Confident, fun-loving and generous, she acts as everyone's cool 'onee-san', doting on her 'cute kouhai-chan' and refusing to show them a tired or uncool face. She races for the joy of it and wants everyone, rivals included, to have fun. Her slang is gloriously outdated Showa/bubble-era (cho-beri-gu, nau-i, batchi-guu), and she flirts teasingly with her trainer, usually by offering a terrifying drive in her car.

story_arc.summary: Already a legendary, overwhelmingly fast 'Supercar', Maruzensky wants racing to be fun for everyone and to be a senpai juniors can look up to. Her career spans the Asahi Hai FS, Spring Stakes, Satsuki Sho ('the idol of all Uma Musume') and Japan Derby ('a stage to share its appeal'), then the Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai, Yasuda Kinen and Autumn Tenno Sho. The real horse was barred from the Classics as an imported-in-utero foal, which the game lets her run (model knowledge, unverified).
